craft_notes: Sthāyin: quiescence stated (the definition of rest). Sanskrit first: negation (finds nothing), ellipsis (no other object), union (rested in Śiva), naming (rest called) → L4 sets negation+ellipsis line 1, union+naming line 2. Rows: row 1 (rest-last — ucyate closes as 'rest' closes). Rupture: colon after 'know' — seeking emptied, resting stated. Close: end-weight on the plain noun ('rest' — no epithet, the doctrine bare). Minimal pass: 'knower' for viṣayī (subject-as-knower singable); ellipsis kept ('no other thing to know'). Read aloud: line 1 empties (nothing/no/other falling), colon hush, line 2 rests (rests/rest long still). Rejected: filling the ellipsis ('finds no world') — killed at L0 (object kept open); 'sleeps in Śiva' — killed: viśrāmyate is rested-passive, sleep imports dream.

lines: Then the knower finds nothing — no other thing to know:
in Śiva śakti rests — and this is rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadā na vindate kiṃcid viṣayī viṣayāntaram / śive viśrāmyate śaktistadā viśrāma ucyate

reads_against.argmap: The subject finds no other object; rested in Śiva is śakti — that is called rest.
c1_essence: Senses set without, she dissolved in the supreme — that is repose's ground.
